description:
Rule-based proxy client on the mihomo core: import, connect, protected ClashFest is a rule-based proxy / VPN client for Android built on the mihomo (Clash.Meta) core. Made for the common case: paste or scan a subscription link, tap Connect, done. The subscription stays untouched; everything you change in the app lives in a separate layer on top of it. Features
  • VLESS (REALITY, XHTTP, Vision), VMess, Trojan, Shadowsocks, Hysteria2, TUIC, WireGuard, SSH, mieru and more, via the mihomo core
  • Subscriptions in Clash YAML format with headers from your operator (quota, expiry, announcements, branding)
  • Per-app routing (allow-list / block-list), rule sets, custom rules, DNS and hosts editor, tunnels
  • Proxy groups inline on the home screen: pick a node, test latency of one node or a whole group
  • Live connections and logs
  • Hardened by default: local SOCKS/HTTP listeners are closed, geo downloads only from trusted mirrors
  • QR scanner without Google services
  • Remote control of a TV box on the same network
Privacy: no analytics, no tracking, no developer server. Your traffic goes to the servers of the operator you chose.
